title: Settings → Email: add and remove a sending-address alias
journey: Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise)
Seed a sending-domain row with DNS records so the row + DNS section render
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/email and expand DNS records on the row
In the Sending-address aliases panel, confirm it starts empty ('No aliases yet')
Enter local-part 'billing' and label 'Billing dept', click Add alias
Confirm the alias appears in the list as billing@<domain> (Billing dept)
Click Remove on the billing alias
Confirm the alias is gone and the panel returns to the empty 'No aliases yet' state
